continue.description: false stops Claude after the hook runs, even when the tool call fails or completes while Claude is still streaming, but does not block this tool call: to block it, also return permissionDecision deny. It does not apply when the permission check refuses the call.

decision.description: Deprecated for PreToolUse: approve maps to permissionDecision allow and block to deny. Use hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision instead.

updatedInput.description: Replaces the entire tool input; permission rules are evaluated against it.

stopReason.description: Shown to the user when continue is false; it stays in the conversation, so Claude sees it if the conversation continues.
